name: Quota Monitor
author: ubyjvovk
description: How much of your LLM subscription quota is left — Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Kimi, DeepSeek, DeepInfra, OpenRouter and RunInfra — as one stacked bar icon with a click-through panel.

barWidget.description: Stacked usage bars, one per provider, filled to that provider's tightest quota window and coloured by severity. Click for windows, credits, reset countdowns, and a Refresh button.
